name: Ford F-450 Super Duty
_note_offsets: JTX builds the Dually Series to the truck and publishes no ET, so these are the offsets this platform actually runs — the documented aftermarket dually range, bracketed by the factory figure. They are the render's offsets, not a menu of anything orderable: a real order is spec'd with JTX.
_note_front: GAP: no public offset figures for wide front wheels on this platform. JTX's own pages say to call a salesperson, and no retailer publishes them. Left null on purpose — the UI says the front is spec'd to the truck rather than inventing a number. One call to JTX fills this in.
_note_body: Estimates until someone puts a tape on a truck — see vehicles.js. measured:false keeps the UI on words, not decimals.
